_note: Clickable things in the garage. 'nodes' are object names from art/garage.glb (prefix match). 'text' is what you see when you click it (the notebook, sticky note, charger and laptop have their own behaviour).

box.name: Pavel's box
box.text: His jacket's on the hook now. In the box: his keys, a tin of screws, a photo of the two of you at the lake, both sunburnt. You put the lid back on.

phone.name: Pavel's phone
phone.text: The cracked phone. One day you'll have the right screen for it.

text_if.text: Pavel's phone. Working again. The scrap screen is a little too big for it.

jacket.name: Pavel's jacket
jacket.text: It still smells of engine oil and the cheap cigarettes he swore he quit.

door.name: Door to the house
door.text: The house is quiet. Mira's alarm is set for six.

window.name: Window
window.text: Rain on the glass. Across the street, Bruno's light is still on.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.text: October. The Marshal smiles at you from the top of the page. Someone (Lena) drew a moustache on him in pencil, very lightly.

bike.name: Lena's bike
bike.text: Pavel fixed the chain last summer. It still doesn't squeak.

toolbox.name: Toolbox
toolbox.text: Your father's toolbox. The lid has a dent from the time Pavel dropped it off the roof.

lamp.name: Bench lamp
lamp.text: It flickers when the plant's night shift starts up. Everyone's power does.
